dateTime.semanticRule: Operational datetimes preserve the event or schedule timezone where local time matters; Europe/Amsterdam is not a universal semantic timezone.

language.rule: Tables that store or directly reference communication with people require explicit language context where language affects communication meaning or routing.

fields.communication_language: Language of a specific communication or communication record.
fields.preferred_language: Preferred language within the applicable relationship or involvement context; not automatically a global Contact property.
fields.source_language: Language in which source evidence was originally supplied.

language.inference: Do not infer communication-related tables from names alone in v0.1; configure them explicitly.

reconciliation.rule: External-system data is evidence, not automatically canonical truth.
reconciliation.implementation: Do not prescribe one field per service or a universal reconciliation table until the specific service and reconciliation behaviour are established.

areasOfInvolvement.rule: Model involvement and context first. Extract shared structure only when it is proven to be shared.
